pd-us-unrenewed.label: US public domain (not renewed)
pd-us-unrenewed.policy: US works published 1929–1963 needed a copyright renewal; Chronicling America only includes titles cleared on that basis. Quote freely, but keep excerpts short anyway because wire and syndicated items can carry separate rights. Link to LOC page images; do not re-host until checked item by item.

in-copyright-quote.label: In copyright: short quotation only
in-copyright-quote.policy: Quote 1–2 sentences for commentary, with full attribution and a link to the licensed archive. No page images. Dutch citation right (Auteurswet art. 15a) for Delpher items; US fair use (17 U.S.C. § 107) for US items.
